### Why the "Unknown Error" Occurred in Google Apps Script

When you selected and ran the event registration function from the Google Apps Script editor toolbar, it failed with an unknown error for three specific technical reasons:

1. **Missing Runtime Parameters in the Editor Toolbar:**
   [`handleEventRegistrationSync(spreadsheet, payload)`](https://github.com/taiwoanuoluwapi/the-affluentaccelerators-website/blob/main/google-sheets-unified-script.js#L425) was written to receive data sent from the website via `doPost(e)`. When executed directly via the Apps Script editor **[Run]** button, `spreadsheet` and `payload` were `undefined`, throwing `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'data')`.
2. **Formula Sheet Dependency Order:**
   The `ensureOverviewDashboardSheet` function ran before `ensureEventRegistrationsSheet`, causing Google Sheets formulas like `=COUNTA('Event Registrations'!C2:C)` to throw formula errors when the `Event Registrations` tab did not exist yet.
3. **Standalone vs Bound Script Reference:**
   In standalone script projects at `script.google.com`, `SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet()` returns `null` unless the explicit Spreadsheet ID is hardcoded.

---

### What Has Been Fixed & Hardened

We updated and fortified [`google-sheets-unified-script.js`](https://github.com/taiwoanuoluwapi/the-affluentaccelerators-website/blob/main/google-sheets-unified-script.js) (as well as [`google-sheets-script.js`](https://github.com/taiwoanuoluwapi/the-affluentaccelerators-website/blob/main/google-sheets-script.js), [`google-sheets-events-script.js`](https://github.com/taiwoanuoluwapi/the-affluentaccelerators-website/blob/main/google-sheets-events-script.js), and [`google-sheets-inquiries-script.js`](https://github.com/taiwoanuoluwapi/the-affluentaccelerators-website/blob/main/google-sheets-inquiries-script.js)):

1. **Direct Spreadsheet ID Binding:**
   Hardcoded your exact spreadsheet ID (`14F30s9WoA2dLDBttEv2jgm3VnPmUJ6xQHT00FIa3-K8`) directly into [`getMasterSpreadsheet()`](https://github.com/taiwoanuoluwapi/the-affluentaccelerators-website/blob/main/google-sheets-unified-script.js#L785) so the script binds to your master Google Sheet whether run as a container-bound script or as a standalone script.
2. **Dedicated One-Click Test Functions Added:**
   Created dedicated zero-argument test functions right at the top of the function dropdown:
   - **`testEventRegistrationForm`**: Dedicated function to test and write sample event registration data in 1 click.
   - **`testConnection`**: Instantly checks your spreadsheet connection and logs all active tabs.
   - **`testUnifiedSetupAndSampleSubmissions`**: Fully sets up all 6 tabs in one click.
3. **Graceful Fallbacks for All Functions:**
   [`handleEventRegistrationSync`](https://github.com/taiwoanuoluwapi/the-affluentaccelerators-website/blob/main/google-sheets-unified-script.js#L425) now includes fallback sample data. Even if you accidentally click **Run** on `handleEventRegistrationSync` directly, it will no longer crash—it will write a test record and log success.
4. **Guaranteed Execution Order & Safe Error Handling:**
   `ensureEventRegistrationsSheet` runs and secures the row **before** the dashboard formulas are built. All dashboard styling and formula operations are wrapped in `try...catch` so non-critical formatting can never interrupt or break registration data ingestion.
5. **Website Endpoint Updated:**
   Updated [`app.js`](https://github.com/taiwoanuoluwapi/the-affluentaccelerators-website/blob/main/app.js#L9) and [`forms.html`](https://github.com/taiwoanuoluwapi/the-affluentaccelerators-website/blob/main/forms.html#L985) to use your active deployment URL:
